title: BusinessCapability
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a particular ability or capacity that a business possesses or exchanges to achieve a specific purpose. Placed in unclassified/ for GSM placement deliberation. Open question: may be better expressed as a property of Structure (capability as purpose of structure) — a capability shares the lifecycle of the realizing structure. TOGAF mapping: Business Capability (Capability-Based Planning, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Capability-Based Planning).

capabilityLevel.description: Capability importance classification. STRATEGIC = differentiating competitive advantage. CORE = essential for business operations. SUPPORTING = enabling but non-differentiating. TOGAF mapping: Capability-Based Planning prioritization.

maturityLevel.description: Capability maturity assessment level. TOGAF mapping: Capability maturity assessment in Architecture Capability Framework.
